source.title: UMB World Rules of Carom Billiard (three cushions)

target.cite: UMB Art 29.1 (the distance is determined by the committee; 15 is the shipped spec-012 default)

two_cue_balls.cite: UMB Art 22.1/23.2/23.4 — the DOCUMENTED v1 shared-white residual (both seats strike ball 0; carom3c.rs header, audit-carom F5): this preset IS the frozen carom3c-v1 behavior point and routes through that untouched id (FR-005)

insufficient_cushions_foul.cite: UMB Art 83 — the v1 classification (cited NON-scoring reason, legal: true; audit-carom F1: identical score/turn consequences, classification surface only)

equal_innings.cite: UMB Art 29.3 (the committee determines whether matches are played with or without an even number of innings — the without regime)

second_ball_visual.cite: UMB Art 22.1 (ball 1 sits on the table from the opening but is never a cue ball under the shared-white residual)

not_modeled.reason: the lag for the choice to begin is a physical pre-match ceremony; initialState(breaker) takes the winner as input (all five 011/012 rulesets share this simplification)
balls-in-motion / leather-tip / touched / pushed-through / frozen-cushion / foot-on-floor / marking / time fouls are physical-world referee judgments not detectable from the ShotRecord event stream
